nyra-letta-orchestrator.display:name: Nyra Letta Orchestrator via Nexus
nyra-letta-orchestrator.description: Default Wave AI mode. Routes through Nexus so Letta can coordinate memory, tools, subscription CLIs, and worker OpenClaw/PicoClaw lanes.

nyra-llxprt-ha.display:name: LLxprt Subscription HA
nyra-llxprt-ha.description: OpenAI-compatible local bridge for subscription-backed CLI routing with failover across Codex, Claude, Gemini, Qwen, Kimi, and local Nexus.

nyra-llxprt-triad.display:name: LLxprt CLI Triad HA
nyra-llxprt-triad.description: Codex, Claude, Gemini, then Qwen/OpenRouter/Nexus fallback. This is the profile Letta should use when it needs subscription-backed agent capacity.

nyra-llxprt-spread.display:name: LLxprt Subscription Spread
nyra-llxprt-spread.description: Round-robin profile for short parallel tasks where provider-side prompt cache locality is less important.

nyra-llxprt-gemini.display:name: LLxprt Gemini OAuth
nyra-llxprt-gemini.description: Gemini OAuth lane for large-context exploration.

nyra-llxprt-claude.display:name: LLxprt Claude OAuth
nyra-llxprt-claude.description: Claude Code subscription lane through LLxprt.

nyra-llxprt-openrouter-free.display:name: LLxprt OpenRouter Free
nyra-llxprt-openrouter-free.description: OpenRouter fallback through LLxprt. Keep the OpenRouter model name current because free-tier models change.

openrouter-qwen-wave-direct.display:name: OpenRouter Qwen Direct
openrouter-qwen-wave-direct.description: Direct Wave AI OpenRouter mode. Store the key as OPENROUTER_KEY in Wave secrets.

groq-kimi-wave-direct.display:name: Groq Kimi Direct
groq-kimi-wave-direct.description: Direct Wave AI Groq mode for Kimi-family free/low-cost fallback when available. Store the key as GROQ_KEY in Wave secrets.

nyra-local-nexus.display:name: Nyra Local Nexus
nyra-local-nexus.description: Private model and MCP route through the orchestrator Nexus endpoint.
